_comment: Shopify page handles that must carry the seo.hidden metafield. Shopify reads namespace seo, key hidden, value 1 and emits noindex plus nofollow on the page AND drops it from sitemap.xml, with no theme code involved. Deleting the metafield reverses both. Source: https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/marketing/optimize-storefront-seo

groups.reason: End-of-unit graded assessments for AP Cybersecurity. CLAUDE.md tier 3: unit tests plus keys are gated, noindex, premium only. Each page served all 20 questions, all four options and a full rationale per option as crawlable HTML, so the instrument and its key were public. Linked from no public nav, so noindex costs no promoted traffic. Confirmed live 2026-09-04: all five returned 200 with no robots meta.

Operator tools, editor shakedown pages, sign-in walls, and one premium delivery page holding answer keys. None carries a custom global.title_tag or an SEO-shaped page title, which is the signal that separates them from the nine pages below that were deliberately invested in. Confirmed live 2026-09-04: all seven returned 200 with no robots meta.

notes.admin-tracker: Operator tool. Prompts for the admin key.
notes.ap-csa-code-editor-test: Shakedown checklist page, not student content.
notes.java-editor-test: Test page. Carries no meta description at all.
notes.cyber-dashboard: The teacher app itself: gradebook, exports, join codes, behind a sign-in. Distinct from cyber-teacher-dashboard, which is its marketing page and stays indexed.
notes.join: Student sign-in wall. An import deleted live content on this handle once (board 112), so no sheet touching it may carry a Body HTML column.
notes.my-progress: Student sign-in wall. Nothing to rank behind it.
notes.ap-csp-teacher-resources: Premium member content. The page itself says files marked KEY are answer keys, for your eyes only. Tier 3.

excluded._comment: Named here rather than merely absent, because docs/meta-description-gaps.md lists all of these under one heading of 17 and a future session WILL find that list again. Measured live 2026-09-04.

seo-invested.reason: Each carries a custom global.title_tag or a written SEO page title. theme.liquid renders global.title_tag when set and otherwise appends the brand suffix, so a title that does not end in the brand is proof someone set one deliberately. Noindexing these would remove pages the site is actively competing with.
